examples.name: Default
examples.summary: Five quote cards at the large size the home page uses, wider together than the row, so the track scrolls and both controls are live. The cards meet with no gutter and the row fades at the end that continues. Drag the track, swipe it, or focus it and use the arrow keys: the step controls are one way in, not the only one. Each control disables itself at its end of the track, so a reader is never offered a step that does nothing.

examples.name: Peek
examples.summary: Small cards, so one lands part-way across the trailing edge under the fade. That partial card is the whole point: it tells a reader the track continues before they have touched a control. Narrow the viewport and the peek stays. The card width is fixed, so the row simply shows fewer of them.

examples.name: Titled cards
examples.summary: kind="cards" separates the cards with a gutter and rounds each one, and the header slot puts the band's title on the row the step controls sit in, with the controls at its end. Every card keeps the default medium width; for the whole band of overline, title, text and link cards reach for the card-carousel section instead of composing one.
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import Carousel from '@aziontech/webkit/carousel'
  import SectionTitle from '@aziontech/webkit/section-title'
  import Topic from '@aziontech/webkit/topic'
</script>

<template>
  <Carousel
    kind="cards"
    aria-label="Ways to use Image Processor"
  >
    <template #header>
      <SectionTitle
        kind="left"
        size="small"
        :framed="false"
        title="See how to use"
      />
    </template>
    <template #controls>
      <Carousel.Previous />
      <Carousel.Next />
    </template>
    <Carousel.Item>
      <Topic
        title="E-commerce product image optimization"
        description="Serve product images at the right size and format for each device, so pages load faster and convert better."
        :heading-level="3"
      />
    </Carousel.Item>
    <Carousel.Item>
      <Topic
        title="News and media site responsive images"
        description="Deliver article images that load instantly on any device, with the format chosen for each browser."
        :heading-level="3"
      />
    </Carousel.Item>
    <Carousel.Item>
      <Topic
        title="User-generated content optimization"
        description="Resize and compress uploaded images on the fly from your storage, with no preprocessing step."
        :heading-level="3"
      />
    </Carousel.Item>
    <Carousel.Item>
      <Topic
        title="Marketplace listing thumbnails"
        description="Crop every seller's photo to the same frame and quality, whatever size it was uploaded at."
        :heading-level="3"
      />
    </Carousel.Item>
  </Carousel>
</template>
